headline_item.title_zh: 黄仁勋呼吁加强中美AI安全对话以应对风险
headline_item.title_en: Sources: Jensen Huang has discussed a comeback as Nvidia CEO with confidants, as allies form a "war room" to lobby for his return and seek White House support (Financial Times)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋在伦敦公开主张通过对话而非监管遏制，促进中美及国际间AI技术安全合作
headline_item.event_summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated in London that the US and China must engage in dialogue and collaboration to ensure AI safety, despite its potential risks. This position aligns with discussions between US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng regarding a national security-level AI communication channel, aiming to establish risk management frameworks amidst global competition.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋、美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特、中国国务院副总理何立峰在伦敦媒体吹风会及中美政府间高层对话：倡议通过技术对话取代单边监管遏制，并推动英、美、中三方AI安全合作
【起因与机理】针对OpenAI等机构对AI生存威胁的担忧，寻求在技术领先性与全球风险治理之间达成平衡
【核心事实细节】黄仁勋反对由AI实验室主导的严苛限制措施，转而倡导中美及英美之间的对话与风险管控。
【各方立场与态度】英伟达试图通过推动对话解决各国出口管制分歧，以维护全球AI供应链及市场准入稳定。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Jensen Huang (CEO of Nvidia), Scott Bessent (US Treasury Secretary), He Lifeng (Chinese Vice Premier): Advocating for dialogue over restrictive regulation and pushing for trilateral AI safety cooperation
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Balancing the need for technical dominance with global risk governance in response to existential AI concerns
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Huang opposes strict regulatory slowdowns, favoring dialogue and risk management between major powers.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Nvidia seeks to stabilize the global AI supply chain and market access through de-escalation of regulatory barriers.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 黄仁勋试图通过弱化“生存威胁”叙事、强化“技术合作”议程，在复杂的地缘政治摩擦中为英伟达的高端算力出口寻找合规回旋空间。这种叙事转换暗示了全球半导体巨头正试图通过塑造“可控的AI共同利益”来缓冲国家安全层面的出口管制压力，维持其中国市场核心份额。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Jensen Huang is attempting to secure a regulatory buffer for Nvidia's high-end computing exports by reframing the AI narrative from 'existential threat' to 'managed cooperation.' This shift suggests a strategic move by semiconductor giants to mitigate export control pressures by framing AI as a shared geopolitical utility, thereby safeguarding their critical market access in China.

headlines.title_zh: 美国会拟收紧AI芯片出口并传唤英伟达高管
headlines.title_en: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
headlines.event_summary_zh: 针对英伟达前高管涉间谍风波，美国会两党推动更严苛的对华出口限制法案并要求英伟达高管出席听证会
headlines.event_summary_en: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott have demanded that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick testify regarding chip export leakages. Legislatively, Congress is reviving the Remote Access Security Act, with House Speaker Mike Johnson confirming a growing bipartisan consensus to further restrict Nvidia's high-end chip exports to China.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】查克·舒默（参议院少数党领袖）、蒂姆·斯科特（银行委员会主席）、迈克·约翰逊（众议院议长）、黄仁勋（英伟达前CEO）、霍华德·卢特尼克（商务部长）在美国国会听证会与立法程序：推动对华芯片出口限制法案，要求企业高管出席听证会解释间谍风波
【起因与机理】因涉及英伟达高端AI芯片非法流向中国的间谍调查引发国家安全担忧
【调查与监管诉求】国会两党就收紧高端AI芯片对华出口达成高度共识。
【各方立场与态度】立法机构正重启《远程访问安全法案》，试图通过立法手段强化全链路出口监管。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Chuck Schumer (Senate Minority Leader), Tim Scott (Banking Committee Chair), Mike Johnson (House Speaker), Jensen Huang (Former Nvidia CEO), Howard Lutnick (Commerce Secretary): Pushing for stricter export restriction bills and subpoenaing corporate leadership
[Root Cause & Mechanism] National security concerns triggered by the illegal diversion of Nvidia AI chips to China
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Bipartisan consensus reached on tightening high-end AI chip exports to China.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Legislative focus on the Remote Access Security Act to reinforce supply chain and access control.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 国会此次行动标志着对单一企业合规管控转向系统性供应链封锁，试图通过强行填补英伟达远程访问与合规漏洞来终结模糊地带。这种由个案引发的政经连锁反应，将迫使英伟达在未来不仅面临单纯的产品限制，更将面临由美国政府主导、针对架构底层访问权限的合规性大清洗。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This congressional move signals a shift from individual corporate oversight to systemic supply chain containment, aiming to eliminate legal grey areas by forcing compliance on Nvidia's remote access protocols. The political fallout will likely force Nvidia to face not just product export caps, but a government-mandated purge of its underlying architectural access privileges.

headlines.title_zh: 台当局拟修改外贸法严控AI服务器对华出口
headlines.title_en: Sources: Nvidia appealed to Taiwanese officials after its manager was charged over chip smuggling, and sought advice from TSMC, which declined to get involved (Mackenzie Hawkins/Bloomberg)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 台湾地区拟将AI服务器与先进制程芯片纳入出口管制清单，违规出口将触犯外贸法，目前正协调产业合规转型
headlines.event_summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs plans to add AI servers and advanced semiconductors to its export control list, making unlicensed shipments to mainland China a criminal offense under the Foreign Trade Act. This move aims to fulfill trade security commitments made to Washington, closing legal loopholes that previously forced prosecutors to rely on breach of trust or document forgery charges.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】台湾经济部、台积电、英伟达在台湾地区出口管制政策框架：拟将AI服务器与先进制程芯片正式纳入外贸法管控，违规将构成刑事犯罪
【起因与机理】为履行对美贸易承诺，解决英伟达芯片走私等供应链合规真空问题
【调查与监管诉求】将AI服务器与高端半导体正式纳入外贸法管控清单。
【各方立场与态度】供应链合规逻辑从企业自律转向政府强制行政管制。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, TSMC, Nvidia: Plan to categorize AI servers and advanced chips under the Foreign Trade Act, making unauthorized exports a crime.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To fulfill trade commitments with the US and bridge regulatory gaps regarding illicit chip shipments.
[Key Metrics] 55% Trading disclosure The above button links to Coinbase.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Supply chain compliance shifted from corporate self-regulation to mandatory state-level oversight.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 台湾当局的立法收紧直接切割了过去英伟达通过第三方渠道的模糊空间，实质上是将服务器代工厂纳入了美式出口制裁的延伸版图。对于台系服务器供应商而言，未来在华合规成本将呈指数级上升，这将迫使产业链进行实质性的产能地理迁徙，以规避潜在的刑事合规风险。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Taiwan's legislative tightening eliminates the grey areas Nvidia previously navigated through third-party intermediaries, effectively incorporating server OEMs into the US-led export sanction regime. For Taiwanese server suppliers, the cost of compliance will skyrocket, forcing an industrial exodus and supply chain migration to mitigate criminal liability risks.

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
